top_signals.title: Ukraine Faces a Growing Air Defense Crisis as Patriot Supplies Dwindle
top_signals.summary: Ukraine's failure to intercept a single Russian missile during a large-scale overnight attack this week has raised fresh concerns over Kyiv's dwindling supply of air-defense interceptors as Moscow escalates its ballistic missile strikes on the nearly defenseless capital and other regions. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that deliveries of anti-ballistic interceptor missiles from partner countries have fallen sharply, leaving Ukraine vulnerable to deadly attacks that are being launched by Russia with increasing frequency. top_signals.title: Fed Rate Hike Doesn't Make Sense Right Now, BlackRock's Rieder Says
top_signals.summary: Rick Rieder, CIO of global fixed income at BlackRock, says the July US employment report most likely takes a Federal Reserve rate hike off the table. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Open," Rieder says a rate cut is still possible this year. (Source: Bloomberg)
